# AI Film Knowledge Base

Repository: https://github.com/62656456/ai-film-knowledge-base

Canonical source language: Simplified Chinese.

Public corpus: 98 Markdown notes.

Start with:
- README.md
- CATALOG.md
- knowledge/00-总纲/
- knowledge/A-理论层/
- knowledge/B-实战层/

Routing:
- Use A for cinematography, directing, screenwriting, and durable film-language theory.
- Use B for storyboard, prompt, shot, action, and platform practice.
- A single note may be used independently; do not require the complete corpus.

Evidence rule: keep stable mechanisms, source-backed interpretations, practical methods, candidate methods, and time-sensitive facts distinct. Recheck changing platform facts against current primary sources. Do not infer unavailable linked content.

Public boundary: do not infer or request excluded personal projects, private retrospectives, AI infrastructure, validation records, inspiration archives, or local image files.
